## Context
Slice C1 (29a9-3cf7-3ded-42d8) recorded 23 below-seam ambient config reads in the LLM subsystem (`llm/`, `llm/plan_review/`, `llm/workflow/`) as `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows, below the composition seam enforced by the in-process AST gate `scripts/check_config_ownership.py`. Parent 075b-1479-dcb7-40ab. Each of the 23, when drained, is STILL FLAGGED (owner=composition in a non-root file); none already owned.

The 23 reads (relative to `src/rebar/llm/`):
- `load_config` (12): code_review/workflow_ops.py, completion.py, enrich_drain.py, plan_review/{__init__,det_floor,drift_floor,pin_health,workflow_ops,xcheck}.py, workflow/{completion_banking,gate_dispatch,gate_ops}.py.
- gate_source.py :: REBAR_GATE_REF, REBAR_GATE_SOURCE, os.environ.get (`_str_pref` feeding `default_ref`/`default_source`).
- sizing.py :: REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET. usage_log.py :: REBAR_USAGE_LOG. completion_banking.py :: REBAR_ROOT. criterion_preview.py :: REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT.
- gate_context.py :: REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED. gate_ops.py :: REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH. executor.py :: os.environ[...]. interpreter.py :: os.environ[...].

Affected SOURCE files: the 21 read-sites plus `config.py`/`_config_sources.py` (owned resolvers) and `config_ownership_exceptions.py` (remove rows). `anthropic_model.py`/`bedrock_model.py` are already roots, untouched.

## Outcome
Each read gets one treatment and its row is removed. `check_config_ownership.py` reports zero findings for these paths, no path-glob exception. Behavioral suites stay green; operation-snapshot fingerprints unchanged except recorded deltas.

## Decision rule
- **(a) CUT-TO-SEAM (19 reads).** A composed-config read is routed through an OWNED `config.py`/`_config_sources.py` resolver and threaded into the below-seam helper (signature RECEIVES it, or the helper calls the resolver internally where the signature must stay fixed). Timing preserved: a LIVE-per-operation read is cut to a resolver that ALSO re-reads env>file>default each call, so a mid-operation override is never lost.
- **(b) OWNED-IN-PLACE via per-line `# read-via:` marker (capped at 4 reads = 4 marked lines).** A read that is NOT composed config (subsystem kill-switch or subprocess/protocol env-control) keeps a marker naming the category. No other listed read may be marked.

### Owned-in-place allowlist (4 marked lines — the cap)
1. `gate_context.py` L201 `REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED` — audited kill-switch escape hatch for agentic file access outside the snapshot gate. 1 line.
2. `workflow/gate_ops.py` L196 `REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH` — kill-switch disabling verify prefetch for the story-a9dd A/B baseline. 1 line.
3. `workflow/executor.py` L442 `os.environ[...]` — workflow `${VAR}` interpolation named by a spec (protocol env-control), raising if unset. 1 line.
4. `workflow/interpreter.py` L206 `os.environ[...]` — same `${VAR}` interpolation. 1 line.

## Plan
1. Add/confirm owned resolvers. REBAR_ROOT in completion_banking is cut to a NEW owned `_config_sources.resolve_run_root(explicit)` for the run-scoped scratch base — precedence explicit>REBAR_ROOT>`Path.cwd()`, with **NO git-toplevel step and NOT realpath-normalized** — mirroring the current `CriterionBank._open`/`for_run` fallback verbatim so the bank dir and repo-leak guard are byte-for-byte unchanged. This is deliberately NOT `repo_root()` (explicit>REBAR_ROOT>git-toplevel>cwd), which would relocate the bank to the git toplevel from a subdir with REBAR_ROOT unset. Add live-per-call `resolve_gate_ref(root)`/`resolve_gate_source(root)` (move `gate_source._str_pref` into the owned seam, env>`[snapshot]`>default), `resolve_plan_review_budget()`, `resolve_usage_log_sink()`, `resolve_preview_timeout()` — each preserving exact precedence/clamping, live per call.
2. Cut the 19 composed-config reads through those resolvers, threading values into helpers (or calling the resolver internally where a signature must stay fixed). The 12 `load_config` reads use `compose_config(root)` at the gate's per-operation composition point.
3. Mark the 4 owned-in-place reads; no other markers. Remove the 23 rows. Run the gate + regression set; keep green. Changed call sites are re-derived (Serena `find_referencing_symbols` + a string `grep`) and brought into scope, or the helper reads the resolver internally.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN)
Held-out `tests/scripts/test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py` (gate scripts imported by BARE name) asserts: (i) `check(REPO_ROOT)` returns no finding for the 21 listed paths; (ii) `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` has zero entries for a listed file; (iii) `# read-via:` markers total exactly 4, confined to gate_context.py/gate_ops.py/executor.py/interpreter.py (1 each). Plus a live-per-call timing regression: a mid-run override of the cut env vars is still observed after the cut (live-per-call, not compose-once). Regression suites kept green: plan_review, workflow, the REBAR_GATE_REF/SOURCE + REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET + REBAR_USAGE_LOG + REBAR_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT + REBAR_ROOT consumer suites, and lifecycle plan-review/gate suites — each injects via the new signature/resolver keeping its assertions.

## Portability & rollback
The gate is in-process AST (no CI-provider trigger); resolvers and markers add no CI dependency. No stored format changes. Rollback = revert.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] No ambient config read remains below the seam in the 21 listed files: 19 cut-to-seam through owned resolvers (live-per-call where the original was live); the 4 enumerated owned-in-place reads carry a per-line `# read-via:` marker (4 lines); no other read marked.
- [ ] The 23 `LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS` rows removed and `check_config_ownership.py` passes with no path-glob exception, proven by the held-out `test_llm_seam_clean_heldout.py` incl. its marker-total==4 / per-file-placement check.
- [ ] The Testing regression suites pass, including the live-per-call timing regression; operation-snapshot fingerprints unchanged except deltas recorded as a comment.
